definition.description: Refreshes OAuth access tokens using a refresh token. Supports Microsoft Azure AD / Entra ID token endpoints for Partner Center, Graph API, Azure Management, and other Microsoft resources. Returns a fresh access token for API calls.

inputFields.helpText: Azure AD / Entra ID tenant ID (GUID). Found in Azure Portal > Azure Active Directory > Overview.
Application (client) ID from your Azure AD app registration.
Client secret from your Azure AD app registration. Keep this secure!
The refresh token obtained from initial OAuth flow. Used to get new access tokens without user interaction.

The resource/audience URL for the token. Common values: https://api.partnercenter.microsoft.com (Partner Center), https://graph.microsoft.com (Graph API), https://management.azure.com (Azure Management).
OAuth scope(s) to request. Default is 'openid'. For Graph API you might use 'openid offline_access'.

outputParameters.description: The new access token to use for API calls. Empty if refresh failed.
New refresh token if rotated, otherwise the original.
The resource the token is valid for.
HTTP status code from token endpoint.
